method: Every path was located via `git log --format=%H|%aI -- <path>` over the full (non-shallow) local clone; the oldest and newest commit touching the path were read byte-for-byte via `git show <commit>:<path>` (read-only Git object inspection, no checkout/reset). Working-tree (current) bytes were read directly from disk and their sha256 compared against the newest commit's blob sha256 to detect any uncommitted drift. No path was renamed, remapped, or hash-retargeted; a mismatch would be reported verbatim, not corrected.
